paper.title: Neural Contextual Bandits with Deep Representation and Shallow Exploration

settings.name_in_paper: Neural contextual bandit (reward r(.) = <theta*, psi(.)> with unknown feature mapping, approximated by deep ReLU network)
unmapped: Reward generating function is unknown; assumed expressible as inner product of last-layer weight theta* with an unknown feature mapping, approximated by an overparameterized deep ReLU network
Each round K raw feature vectors x_{t,k} in R^d with ||x||_2=1 are revealed (context sequence not specified as stochastic)
Regret is conditional on random network initialization; bound holds w.p. 1-delta over initialization
NTK matrix positive definite (lambda_min(H) >= lambda_0) and first-order stability of network gradient (Assumption 2)
settings.definition_quote: we assume that the reward generating function $r(\cdot)$ can be expressed as the inner product between a deep represented feature vector and an exploration weight parameter, namely, $r(\cdot)=\la\btheta^*,\bpsi(\cdot)\ra$ ... $\empR(\xb_{t,k})=r(\xb_{t,k})+\xi_t$, where $\xi_t$ is an independent $\nu$-subGaussian random noise

symbols.alpha_T: exploration parameter nu*sqrt(2(d log(1+T log(H K)/lambda)+log(1/delta)))+lambda^{1/2} M
symbols.G: bound on norm of the learned features phi(x; w)
symbols.L_layers: number of hidden layers of the network
symbols.E_err: ||r - r_tilde||_{H^{-1}}: NTK-weighted error between true rewards and network outputs

conditions: first-order stability of network gradient w.r.t. inputs (Assumption 2)
NTK matrix positive definite, lambda_min(H) >= lambda_0 > 0 (Assumption 3)
network width m = poly(L, d, 1/delta, H, log(TK/delta))
tuning: step size eta_q <= C_0 (d^2 m n T^{5.5} L^6 log(TK/delta))^{-1}
network retrained every H steps with n gradient-descent iterations

source.label: thm:regret
source.quote: Suppose Assumptions \ref{asp:nondegen}, \ref{asp:gradient_fos} and \ref{asp:ntk_pd} hold. Assume that $\|\btheta^*\|_2\leq M$ for some positive constant $M>0$. For any $\delta\in(0,1)$, let us choose $\alpha_t$ ... With probability at least $1-\delta$ over the randomness of the initialization of the neural network, it holds that $R_T\leq C_1\alpha_T\sqrt{Td\log(1+ \frac{TG^2}{\lambda d})}+\frac{C_2\fosPara \layerLen^3 d^{5/2}T\sqrt{\log m\log(\frac{1}{\delta})\log(\frac{TK}{\delta})}\|\rb-\tilde\rb\|_{\Hb^{-1}}}{m^{1/6}}$

results.notes: R_T is expectation over reward noise conditioned on initialization; bound holds w.p. 1-delta over initialization. Recorded as pseudo-regret with high_probability. Paper's m (width) renamed m_width; L (layers) renamed L_layers. Remark 6: if E_err=O(1) and m>=T^3 the regret becomes O~(sqrt(T)). Setting mapping to structured_general is approximate.
